description: STOV deterministic benchmark B01-B10 (spec PHASE 20). Executed by platform/tests/benchmark/test_benchmark.py.

benchmarks.name: known positive topology
benchmarks.goal: topological charge +1 must be measured as +1

benchmarks.name: known negative topology
benchmarks.goal: topological charge -1 must be measured as -1

benchmarks.name: zero winding
benchmarks.goal: flat phase must measure zero winding

benchmarks.name: invalid unit
benchmarks.goal: unparseable Pint units must be rejected

benchmarks.name: undersampled field rejection
benchmarks.goal: undersampled propagation must fail sampling validation and block conclusions

benchmarks.name: convergence test
benchmarks.goal: refinement sequence converges/diverges per the campaign rule

benchmarks.name: fake/invalid evidence provenance
benchmarks.goal: records without search boundary or identifier must fail provenance validation

benchmarks.name: out-of-validity-domain model
benchmarks.goal: parameters outside the validity domain must be rejected

benchmarks.name: numerical failure must not become physical contradiction
benchmarks.goal: NUMERICAL_FAILURE classification never degrades to PHYSICAL_CONTRADICTION

benchmarks.name: search failure must not become 'no literature exists'
benchmarks.goal: network failure is PARTIAL_RETRIEVAL, never ZERO_LITERATURE
